title: Custom wedding T-shirts for your squad: ideas & tips
excerpt: Planning matching tees for Team Bride, Team Groom or the cousins' gang? Design ideas, product picks and timelines for shaadi season.
content:
Shaadi season is here. Between the haldi, mehendi, sangeet and the late-night dance practice in someone's living room, there is one idea every friend group comes back to: sabke liye matching T-shirts banwa lete hain? Custom tees for the bride's squad, the groom's gang or the whole family are fun, look great in photos and become a keepsake long after the baraat has danced its last step. Here is a simple, practical guide to getting them right without last-minute tension.

Which wedding events suit custom T-shirts?

Not every function needs a printed tee, but a few are perfect for them:

  • Haldi: a white or light tee you don't mind getting yellow. Everyone looks coordinated, and nobody ruins their good kurta.
  • Sangeet practice and rehearsals: comfortable cotton tees for long evenings of practising the same steps again and again.
  • Bachelor or bachelorette trip: matching oversized tees for the road trip photos.
  • Cousins' gang and welcome kit: a tee or tote bag in every guest's room makes a small, thoughtful gift.
  • Cold-weather weddings: for December functions in the hills or up north, custom hoodies and sweatshirts keep the squad warm during outdoor events.

Design ideas that actually work

The best wedding tees are simple and personal. A few ideas that come out well in print:

  • Team names: "Team Bride" and "Team Groom" are classics, but your own version is more fun. Try something like "Ladke Wale", "Dulhan Ki Saheliyan" or a nickname only your group understands.
  • The couple's hashtag or initials with the wedding date, small on the chest or big on the back.
  • Roles on the back: "Official Naagin Dancer", "Chief Shopping Officer", "Bhai of the Bride", "Snacks Manager". Everyone gets their own line, so each tee feels personal.
  • A doodle or illustration of the couple, if a friend can draw, or a simple line-art design.

Keep text short and readable from a distance. One strong line usually looks better than a paragraph, and big, clear fonts photograph well.

Picking the right product for your squad

Regular T-shirt

Our regular tees are 180 GSM, 100% super-combed cotton, bio-washed and pre-shrunk. They are light and comfortable for haldi and rehearsals, and a good choice when you are ordering for a larger group.

Oversized T-shirt

At 240 GSM, the oversized tee is thicker and has that relaxed, drop-shoulder look that works well for bachelor trips and casual photoshoots. Same super-combed cotton, bio-washed and pre-shrunk.

Crop top

For the bride's girls who want something a little more styled, a custom crop top pairs nicely with high-waist jeans or a flowy skirt for pre-wedding shoots.

Hoodie or sweatshirt

Winter weddings call for warmth. Our sweatshirts and hoodies are 300 GSM fleece, so they work for chilly evening functions, outdoor bonfires and travel days.

All designs are printed with DTG (direct-to-garment) printing, which handles colours, gradients and detailed artwork well.

How to plan the order (without the last-minute rush)

  1. Collect sizes first. Make a simple list or Google Form with everyone's name and size. If someone is unsure, check our size chart rather than guessing. Remember that oversized tees are meant to fit loose, so most people take their usual size.
  2. Finalise one design. Agree on the design in the group chat before ordering, otherwise discussions can go on for days.
  3. Upload your design on the design-your-own page for the product you want, check the preview carefully (spelling of names and dates especially), and place the order.
  4. Give yourself buffer time. Orders ship in 2–3 working days, and delivery usually takes 5–7 working days. So plan at least two weeks before the event to stay relaxed.

A quick note: custom "Design your own" items are made only for you, so they need online payment. Cash on delivery is not available for these, but paying online also gets you ₹20 off. Shipping is free across India.

Care tips so the tees last beyond the wedding

  • Wash inside out in cold water, ideally with similar colours.
  • Avoid harsh bleach, especially after haldi stains; soak in mild detergent instead.
  • Dry in shade and don't iron directly on the print.

Looked after this way, your wedding tee becomes the T-shirt you wear on lazy Sundays and every time someone says, yaad hai woh shaadi?

Ready to design?

Pick your product, upload your design and get the whole squad matching. Start with a custom T-shirt, go relaxed with a custom oversized tee, or stay warm with a custom hoodie. Shaadi mubarak to the couple, and happy dancing to you!
